parsed.root_cause: The incident was caused by the Kubernetes control plane components (Controller Manager and Scheduler) becoming unreachable, likely due to expired client certificates used for authentication.
evidence: Alerts indicate KubeClientCertificateExpiration with less than 24 hours remaining.
Prometheus reports KubeControllerManagerDown and KubeSchedulerDown, indicating these critical control plane components are not being scraped or are down.
Kubernetes events show FailedScheduling and VolumeFailedDelete errors, which are direct consequences of the scheduler and controller manager being unavailable.
